fact_text: Net interest margin is the spread between the yield on earning assets and the cost of deposits and other liabilities, and it is the core earnings spread for banks.

fact_text: As policy rates fall, banks cut deposit rates to protect their net interest margins, according to the analyst.

fact_text: Given premium valuations, the analyst sees a risk of profit-taking in bank stocks at some point.

fact_text: Bank stocks have driven much of the index gain while many other sectors have fallen, and the analyst expects possible sector switching into cement.
